Sara —

Thanks, and great to see the timeline. I've attached our vendor intake checklist below and included the minimum required fields so we can complete vendor creation and generate POs. If Novalytics can return the items marked "Required", we should be able to issue a PO before July 26.

Required fields (please return as a single PDF if possible):
- Legal entity name (as it appears on W-9 or tax docs)
- W-9 (or local equivalent) 
- Remit-to name and full address (for our AP file)
- ACH authorization form OR wire instructions (bank name, account name, account number, routing/IBAN, SWIFT)
- Billing contact name/email and purchase-order contact name/email

Optional but helpful:
- Insurance certificate (if you will be on-site or handling sensitive data)
- Net terms preference (Net30 is default; Net45/Net60 require approval)

Notes on PO/terms:
- Our standard PO header will include a Redwood PO number (PO-RWD-YYYY-####). Please reference that on all invoices.
- Default payment terms: Net30 from invoice receipt; early-pay discounts may be considered by finance (cc'ing Laura).
- For wire transfers, our finance team will confirm bank details when issuing payment; please ensure the ACH form includes an authorized signatory.

I attach: 1) Redwood_vendor_intake_checklist.pdf (filled template) 2) short process cheat-sheet for first invoice. If you prefer, we can do a 20-minute call Monday to walk through the fields.
